svg.title: Dockworker — Queer person
svg.desc: A fictional queer person whose gender is unspecified working as dockworker, wearing a safety vest and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A strapped cargo box sits above the low fork of a pallet jack with a tall narrow steering handle and two wheels. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
